verdict.rationale: Sardine is an AML/compliance platform, so a human-approval gate before submitting a regulatory report (e.g., a SAR) is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions filing regulatory reports or an approval step before external submission. Analyst review of sanctions matches and case management are related features, not an approval control on outbound reports.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can require an authorized human approval before an externally submitted regulatory report
